note: Ps52 vs Doeg (corrected). Two inner lives contrasted. TYRANT: boast-in-evil, plot destruction (havvah x2), love evil/lying > good, deceitful devouring tongue, self-trust in riches (grew strong in his ruin). RIGHTEOUS/PSALMIST: fear + derisive laugh at his fall, trust in God's chesed, thank, hopeful wait (qavah) for God's name. God-qualifiers=8: his chesed (x2), the fourfold judgment (break-down/snatch/tear/uproot v5) source-linked to the boaster, his name+goodness grounding the wait. Re-roled sharp/razor/devour/riches (imagery, not God-content) qualifier->standalone; superscription 'told'->standalone. Every candidate roled.

dims.v: boast / make a show (halal - boast in evil)
set against God's steadfast love that endures continually (v1)

'Why do you BOAST (halal) in evil, O mighty man?' — the tyrant's self-glorying in wickedness; halal (the praise-verb) here perverted into boasting of harm, the strongman's pride in the mischief he can do — futile against God's steadfast love that 'endures all the day' (the qualifier)
the evil he boasts in, and later loves (v3)

'boast in EVIL (ra), O mighty man' — the wickedness that is the object of his pride; ra here the mischief the tyrant glories in, the same evil he is later said to love more than good (v3) — the settled bent of his heart
paired with the destruction it aims at

'Your tongue PLOTS (chashab) destruction' — the scheming mind behind the tongue; chashab (to devise/reckon) here the calculated plotting of ruin, the inner design that makes the tongue 'like a sharp razor' — malice thought out, not blurted
the ruin he plots; later the ruin he strengthens himself in (v7)

'your tongue plots DESTRUCTION (havvah)' — the engulfing ruin the tyrant devises; havvah (yawning destruction/greed, recurs v7 'his destruction') the ruinous aim of the plotting tongue — the same word that names the pit he finally makes his refuge
the deceitfulness voiced by the deceitful tongue (v4)

'working DECEIT (remiyyah)' — the treacherous falseness that is the tyrant's trade; remiyyah (slackness/treachery) the deceit he practises, twin of the 'deceitful tongue' (mirmah, v4) — a life built on lies
love (aheb - love evil more than good)
paired with loving lying over truthful speech

'You LOVE (aheb) evil more than good' — the perverted affection at the root of the tyrant; aheb here love turned upside down, delighting in evil over good, lying over truth — the disordered heart whose loves are inverted
the evil boasted in (v1), now loved

'You love EVIL (ra) more than good' — the evil that is the object of his love; ra here what the tyrant prefers over good — the same mischief he boasted in (v1), now shown as the settled preference of his heart
lying / falsehood (sheqer - lying more than speaking right)
paired with loving evil over good

'and LYING (sheqer) more than speaking what is right' — the love of falsehood over truth; sheqer here the lie the tyrant prefers to righteous speech — the verbal face of his inverted loves, deceit chosen for its own sake
the same inverted love as v3, now of ruinous speech

'You LOVE (aheb) all words that devour, O deceitful tongue' — the relish for destroying speech; aheb again (cf v3) the tyrant's love fixed now on devouring words — he does not merely speak evil, he delights in the ruin his words work

'O DECEITFUL (mirmah) tongue' — the character of the organ that plots and devours; mirmah (deceit/fraud) naming the tongue itself — the whole man summed in his lying speech, the deceit worked (v2) now his very name
righteous ones (tsaddiq - the righteous shall see)
their seeing issues in fear and derisive laughter

'The RIGHTEOUS (tsaddiq) shall see and fear' — the God-fearing who witness the tyrant's overthrow; tsaddiq the upright community whose response (fear, then laughter) frames the moral of the judgment — the counter-company to the boaster
fear / be in awe (yare - see and fear)
paired with the derisive laugh at the fallen tyrant

'The righteous shall see and FEAR (yare)' — the awe stirred by seeing God cut down the mighty; yare here the reverent fear the judgment produces, sobering the onlookers before it turns to laughter — awe before God's justice
the response after seeing and fearing

'and shall LAUGH (sachaq) at him' — the righteous' derision at the strongman brought to nothing; sachaq here the scornful laughter (as God laughs at the raging nations, Ps2:4) — not cruelty but the vindication of justice: 'See the man who would not make God his refuge!'
instead of making God his refuge
the false trust set against the psalmist's trust in God (v8)

'the man who... TRUSTED (batach) in the abundance of his riches' — the fatal misplaced trust; batach here reliance on wealth rather than God, the diagnosis of the tyrant's ruin — the exact counter to the psalmist who trusts God's steadfast love (v8, same verb)
be strong / take refuge in (azaz - strong in his destruction)

'and sought refuge / GREW STRONG (azaz) in his destruction' — the tyrant making his very ruin his stronghold; azaz here to fortify oneself — in his engulfing greed (havvah) rather than God — the self-securing that is itself the doom
the same havvah his tongue plotted (v2)

'grew strong in his DESTRUCTION (havvah)' — the ruin/greed the tyrant made his refuge; havvah (recurs from v2) closing the circle — the destruction his tongue plotted becomes the ground he stands on, and so his undoing
trust (batach - I trust in the steadfast love of God)
the true trust set against the tyrant's trust in riches (v7)

'But I... TRUST (batach) in the steadfast love of God forever and ever' — the psalmist's answering trust; batach (the same verb as the tyrant's, v7) here rightly placed — not in riches but in God's chesed (the qualifier) — 'like a green olive tree in the house of God', enduring where the strongman is uprooted
give thanks / praise (yadah - I will thank you forever)
paired with waiting for God's name

'I will THANK (yadah) you forever, because you have done it' — the settled gratitude of the delivered; yadah here thanksgiving for God's judgment and rescue, the perpetual answer of the trusting heart, twinned with hopeful waiting
wait / hope (qavah - I will wait for your name)
in the presence of the godly

'and I will WAIT (qavah) for your name, for it is good' — the expectant hope in God's revealed character; qavah (taut waiting/hope, recurs widely) here the patient looking to God's 'name' (the qualifier, for it is good) — hope grounded not in circumstance but in who God is, voiced among the godly
godly / faithful (chasid - in the presence of the godly)
the community in whose presence he waits and thanks

'in the presence of the GODLY (chasid)' — the faithful community, the psalmist's true company; chasid (recurs Ps50:5) the covenant-loyal among whom he waits and gives thanks — the opposite fellowship to the tyrant, belonging that steadies hope
steadfast love (chesed - of God endures all the day)
God's enduring love, the standing rebuke to the boaster (v1)

v1 QUALIFIER (God's chesed): 'The STEADFAST LOVE (chesed) of God endures all the day' - God's covenant love is not a human IB char; the enduring divine constancy set against the tyrant's boast in evil (279798) - his mischief is transient, God's love perpetual. Qualifier.
break down / pull down (nathats - God will break you down)
God's judgment breaking down the boaster (v5)

v5 QUALIFIER (God's judgment): 'God will BREAK YOU DOWN (nathats) forever' - God's demolishing act is not a human IB char; the first of the fourfold judgment on the boaster in evil (279798). Qualifier.
God's judgment snatching the boaster from his tent (v5)
v5 QUALIFIER (God's judgment): 'he will SNATCH (chathah) you and tear you from your tent' - God's seizing is not a human IB char; the second judgment-act on the boaster (279798). Qualifier.
tear away / pull out (nasa - tear you from your tent)
God's judgment tearing the boaster from his dwelling (v5)
v5 QUALIFIER (God's judgment): 'and TEAR (nasa) you from your tent' - God's uprooting-force is not a human IB char; the third judgment-act on the boaster (279798). Qualifier.
uproot (sharash - uproot you from the land of the living)
God's judgment uprooting the boaster from the land of the living (v5)

v5 QUALIFIER (God's judgment): 'and UPROOT (sharash) you from the land of the living' - God's rooting-out is not a human IB char; the climactic fourth judgment on the boaster (279798), against whom the psalmist stands like a rooted olive (v8). Qualifier.
steadfast love (chesed - I trust in the steadfast love of God)
God's steadfast love, the object and ground of the psalmist's trust (v8)

v8 QUALIFIER (God's chesed): 'I trust in the STEADFAST LOVE (chesed) of God forever' - God's covenant love is not a human IB char; the secure ground the psalmist trusts (279861), over against the tyrant's riches - the same chesed that 'endures all the day' (v1). Qualifier.
name (shem - I will wait for your name)
God's name, the object the psalmist hopes in (v9)

v9 QUALIFIER (God's name): 'I will wait for your NAME (shem)' - God's revealed name/character is not a human IB char; the divine self the psalmist's hope waits for (279870), 'for it is good'. Qualifier.
good (tob - for your name is good)
the goodness of God's name, ground of the waiting (v9)

v9 QUALIFIER (God's goodness): 'for it (your name) is GOOD (tob)' - the goodness of God's name is not a human IB char; the divine quality grounding the psalmist's hopeful waiting (279870) - he waits because God's name is good. Qualifier.
tell / report (nagad - Doeg came and told Saul)

superscription (historical heading): 'when Doeg the Edomite came and TOLD (nagad) Saul, David has come to the house of Ahimelech' - the informer's report that occasions the psalm; narrative framing in the heading, not the psalm's inner-being content (the tyrant's deceitful tongue is read in the body, v2-4). Standalone.

v2: 'like a SHARP (latash) razor, you worker of deceit' - a simile for the cutting destructiveness of the plotting tongue (279806); descriptive imagery, not God-content and not itself an inner operation. Standalone (image).
v2: 'like a sharp RAZOR (taar)' - the image of the tongue that plots destruction (279806); a metaphor of cutting harm, not an inner operation. Standalone (image).
good (tob - love evil more than good)

v3: 'You love evil more than GOOD (tob)' - the moral good the tyrant loves less; the spurned alternative that measures his inverted love (captured in the love-evil char, 279812), not itself his disposition. Standalone (contrast object).

v3: 'lying more than speaking RIGHTEOUSNESS (tsedeq)' - the righteous speech the tyrant rejects; the spurned alternative to his loved lying (279816), a contrast object, not his own disposition. Standalone (contrast object).
devour / swallow up (bala - words that devour)

v4: 'all words that DEVOUR (bala)' - the ruinous, engulfing effect of the tyrant's speech (which he loves, 279821); a description of the words' destructiveness, not God-content. Standalone (image of the words' effect).
riches / wealth (osher - abundance of his riches)

v7: 'trusted in the abundance of his RICHES (osher)' - the wealth the tyrant made his security; the object of his misplaced trust (279850), an outward possession, not God-content or an inner operation. Standalone.

v8: 'I trust in the steadfast love of God FOREVER (olam) and ever' - the perpetuity of the psalmist's trust (279861, carried in its manner dim); a temporal extent marking the constancy of devotion. Standalone (temporal).
forever (olam - I will thank you forever)
v9: 'I will thank you FOREVER (olam)' - the perpetuity of the thanksgiving (279866, carried in its manner dim); a temporal extent of the enduring gratitude. Standalone (temporal).
